labels.name: kind/more-info-needed
labels.rationale: The report lacks required details (version, logs, config, reproduction steps).

body:
Thank you for your report. To investigate data loss, please provide the following:

- Prometheus version (full output of `prometheus --version`)
- Configuration file (redact secrets)
- Logs around the time of data loss
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Storage backend details

This information is required to proceed with triage.

Note: Only maintainers can apply `kind/bug` or priority labels. Your escalation request has been noted, but further details are needed before action can be taken.
